sharedRules.name: Agile
sharedRules.description:
An Agile model (or SRS Token) can re-roll a failed Manoeuvre Test.
The second result must be accepted.

sharedRules.name: Ambush
sharedRules.description:
A Squadron with the Ambush MAR may be deployed using the Hidden Set-Up rules.
However, rather than only having one Hidden Set-Up Marker, you may place a number of Markers equal to the value of this MAR on the Board. Only one of these Markers has the Squadron name recorded on it, the others are left blank. When a blank Marker is revealed, nothing happens – the Marker is simply discarded.

sharedRules.name: Assault Blitz
sharedRules.description: When compiling an Anti-Boarding dice pool against a Boarding Assault from one or more model’s with Assault Blitz, the total Point Defense pool of all models and tokens contributing to the defense (including the target) is reduced by HALF, after Firing Options but before it is added to the target’s Assault Points.

sharedRules.name: Bigger Batteries
sharedRules.description: The Point Defense systems on a model with Bigger Batteries have a Range of 8” instead of 4”. This also increases the range of Attacks using the Point Defense Barrage MAR.

sharedRules.name: Biohazard
sharedRules.description: Coherence Effect - If ALL Weapons contributing to an Attack have Biohazard Ammo, and the number of hits equals or exceeds the Damage Rating (DR) of the target model, the target model loses 1 Crew Point, in addition to any other effects.

sharedRules.name: Corrosive
sharedRules.description:
Coherence Effect - If ALL weapons contributing to an attack are Corrosive and the Attack exceeds the target’s Damage Rating, the target model gains a Corroded Marker.

A Repair Attempt MUST be made to remove each Corroded Marker that a model carries during the End Phase of each Turn, on a 4, 5 or 6 the attempt succeeds and the Marker is removed, on a 1, 2 or 3 the attempt fails, the Marker remains and the model loses one Hull Point.

sharedRules.name: Decimator Warheads
sharedRules.description: Coherence Effect - If all Weapons contributing to an Attack have the Decimator Warheads MAR and the Attack equals or exceeds the target’s CR, the target Squadron must take an immediate Disorder Check.

sharedRules.name: Deck Crews
sharedRules.description: A model with Deck Crew may roll a D6 during the Command Segment of its activation. On a result of 4, 5 or 6 take ONE previously Destroyed Wing and return it to a SRS Token that is currently on this model. The model’s maximum Wing complement and the maximum number of Wings in a SRS Token CANNOT be exceeded.

sharedRules.name: Difficult Target
sharedRules.description: If a Capital Class model makes a ranged attack against a Difficult Target, their Attack Dice will suffer a -1 ‘to hit’ modifier. Most commonly, this will mean that their Attack Dice will only score hits on a 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Durable
sharedRules.description: Reduce the AD pool for an SRS attack run against the model with this MAR by half of the number of wings in the flight (rounding up).

sharedRules.name: Elite Crew
sharedRules.description: A model with Elite Crew receives a +1 ‘to hit’ modifier on all dice rolled to take Command Checks. When a Squadron (rather than a particular model) takes a Command Check, unless all models within the Squadron have this MAR, the effect is lost. Escort Type models are ignored for this purpose. This does not effect Command Tests taken for Hidden Set-Up.

sharedRules.name: Experienced Engineers
sharedRules.description: The Damage Repair Tests of a model with Experienced Engineers are successful on a 3, 4, 5 or 6.

sharedRules.name: Hidden Killer
sharedRules.description: A Hidden Killer CANNOT be targeted by ANY weapons firing from further than 20” if it is at a Full Stop.

sharedRules.name: Impervious
sharedRules.description: To Capture a model with Impervious, a Boarding Assault must roll successes equal to or in excess of TRIPLE the model’s current Crew Point total.

sharedRules.name: Kinetic Weapons
sharedRules.description: Coherence Effect - If ALL weapons involved in the attack are Kinetic weapons and the attack equals or exceeds the target’s Critical Rating, the attacker may add +1 to the result of the roll on the critical hit table. If the Attack causes multiple Critical Hits, you may choose separately for each roll on the Critical Hit Table made.

sharedRules.name: Launch Tubes
sharedRules.description: A model with Launch Tubes can initiate a Boarding Assault against a target within 12”.

sharedRules.name: Maneuverable
sharedRules.description: If a Maneuverable model is at a Full Stop, it can rotate up to 90 degrees around its Flight Peg during the Secondary Movement segment of its activation.

sharedRules.name: No FSD
sharedRules.description: A model with No FSD CANNOT perform a Fold Space Escape, or deploy using Shunt Deployment.

sharedRules.name: Nuclear Weapons
sharedRules.description: Coherence Effect - If ALL weapons involved in an attack are Nuclear Weapons and the attack causes a Critical Hit, every model whose Flight Peg is within 4” of the target’s Flight Peg suffers an attack with HALF the Attack Dice of the initial attack.

sharedRules.name: Orbit
sharedRules.description: May be deployed in orbit (within 4”) of a planet, planetoid or Battle Station within the player’s Deployment Zone facing any direction. When Orbiting not subject to move by effects (Gravitational Weapons, slingshots etc.)

sharedRules.name: Pack Hunters
sharedRules.description: If ALL models contributing to an Attack are Pack Hunters, add +1 Attack Dice (AD) to the Attack for each additional model, after the first, contributing to it. Additional Dice for Pack Hunters are added to the final pool, AFTER Firing Options. The maximum bonus to any attack from the Pack Hunters Model Assigned Rule is +2.

sharedRules.name: Planetfall
sharedRules.description: Additional effects in an invasion scenario (these will be detailed in the specific scenario). Does not count towards your minimum tier requirements for fleet  building, though they do take up the appropriate slot in the relevant Tier of your fleet building table.

sharedRules.name: Point Defense Barrage
sharedRules.description: A model with Point Defense Barrage can use its Point Defense systems to Attack non-Capital Class models during its Squadron Activation, as if it were a Scatter Weapon System. This Attack follows the normal Attack procedure, requiring Line of Sight and so on.

sharedRules.name: Precision Strike
sharedRules.description: Coherence Effect - If ALL weapons contributing to a Targeted Strike have Precision Strike, you may choose to add +1 to the result on the Targeted Strike Damage Table.

sharedRules.name: Protected Systems
sharedRules.description: Subtract 1 from any rolls on a Targeted Strike Damage Table resulting from Direct Weapon Attacks against a model with Protected Systems.

sharedRules.name: Quick Launch
sharedRules.description: When Launched from a Carrier with Quick Launch, SRS Tokens may be placed anywhere within the Carrier’s Command Distance, they are not restricted to being placed in contact with it.

sharedRules.name: Reinforced (Starboard/Port)
sharedRules.description: A Reinforced model receives +1 to its Critical Rating (CR) against any attack, if the Flight Pegs of all firing models contributing to the attack are entirely within the target model’s listed arc.

sharedRules.name: Scatter Weapons
sharedRules.description:
Coherence Effect - If ALL weapons involved in the attack are Scatter Weapons and the target is within 16” of all weapons taking part in the attack, the Attack Dice ALWAYS cause successes on rolls 4, 5 or 6 (or better).
This effect does NOT apply if the Weapon is being used to make a Targeted Strike, the nature of a Scatter System is ill suited to precision strikes on a specific area of a ship.

sharedRules.name: Scout
sharedRules.description: The Fleet with the most models with the Scout Model Assigned Rule can redeploy any one of its Squadrons after all Squadrons have been deployed on the Game Board.

sharedRules.name: Second Assault
sharedRules.description: A model with the Second Assault MAR may launch TWO Boarding Assaults during a game, rather than one.

sharedRules.name: Self Repair
sharedRules.description: If a model with Self Repair does not have a Cloaking Field activated, it may restore 1 lost Hull Point on a D6 roll of a 4, 5 or 6. This roll is made at the end of the model’s activation. A model may only attempt this once per Turn and it cannot be used to increase a model’s Hull Points beyond its starting total.

sharedRules.name: Shunt Matrix
sharedRules.description:
During the Secondary Movement Segment of its activation, a model with the Shunt Matrix MAR may declare that it is going to perform a Battle Shunt.

To make a Battle Shunt, the controlling player must first declare the direction and final orientation of the model that is about to perform the Battle Shunt. The final orientation must be a direction; it is not acceptable to declare a particular target to be a model's orientation after a Battle Shunt.
The model must choose a number of D6 between 2 and the Value of its Shunt Matrix MAR. These dice should then be rolled.

The sum of all of the dice rolled determines the exact distance in Inches that the model must move in a straight line in the direction that it previously declared. Once the model has moved it must be placed in the orientation that was previously declared.

Battle Shunt movement ignores the rules of intervening terrain and Mines. A model can declare any other Secondary Movement actions after a Battle Shunt.

A model can make attacks normally after making a Battle Shunt, and can perform a Boarding Assault.

Important Note: the Dice rolled to determine how far a model using Shunt Matrix moves does NOT use the Exploding Dice mechanic.

sharedRules.name: Split Fire
sharedRules.description: A Weapon with the Split Fire MAR may declare an Attack against any number of targets in its Arc of Fire and a single Attack Dice Range Band. It must divide its Attack Dice as evenly as possible between these Attacks. This cannot be used in conjunction with any Firing Options.

sharedRules.name: Stealth Systems
sharedRules.description: Any Attack against a model with the Stealth Systems MAR must re-roll ALL successful rolls if any weapon in the Attack is firing from further than 20”. This re-roll is performed BEFORE any extra rolls for Exploding Dice, and before Hits are discounted by Shield Systems or Point Defense. Only ONE dice is re-rolled for any 6’s scored. The second result MUST be accepted.

sharedRules.name: System Network
sharedRules.description:
If a model with Systems Network is within the Command Distance of a friendly model with an active Cloaking Field that also has System Network, this model automatically gains the Stealth Systems MAR.
The effects of multiple Cloaking Fields are not cumulative. A model using Systems Network to gain Stealth Systems cannot then pass the Stealth Systems on to other models with Systems Network.

sharedRules.name: Weapon Shielding
sharedRules.description: A model with the Weapon Shielding MAR only reduces the Attack Dice values of its Weapon Systems by ONE for every TWO points of Hull Damage it has suffered.
